terms.acceptance.text: By downloading, installing, or using SnapSong (the "App" or "Service"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Use. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you may not use the App. Your continued use of SnapSong following any updates to these terms indicates your acceptance of those changes.
terms.service.title: Description of Service
terms.service.text: SnapSong is an AI-powered music generation app that analyzes photos you provide and creates original songs based on their visual content. The service uses OpenAI's vision and language models to analyze your photos and generate lyrics, and Suno's audio synthesis technology to create the musical composition. An active internet connection is required to generate songs. Generated songs are stored on your device and may be played, shared, or used according to the license terms outlined in this agreement.

terms.eligibility.text: You must be at least 13 years old to use SnapSong. If you are under 18 years of age, you represent that you have obtained parental or guardian consent to use the App and agree to these terms. If you are a parent or guardian, you are responsible for monitoring and supervising your minor child's use of SnapSong. By allowing a minor to use the App, you assume all responsibility and liability for their actions and agree to be bound by these terms on their behalf.

terms.content.generatedSongs.text: Songs generated by SnapSong are created through the combined use of AI analysis and synthesis. You receive a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use generated songs for personal, non-commercial purposes. This means you may listen to, save, and share your generated songs privately with friends and family.

terms.subscriptions.plans.text: SnapSong offers a free tier with limited monthly song generations and a Premium subscription offering additional generations and commercial use rights. Specific features and limitations of each plan are detailed within the App.

terms.subscriptions.appStore.text: All subscriptions are managed and billed through the Apple App Store. By purchasing a Premium subscription through SnapSong, you agree to Apple's App Store terms and conditions regarding billing, auto-renewal, and cancellation. TrueTapp does not directly process or store your payment information; all payments are handled securely by Apple.
